name: Beth and Morty
source:
Your mother demands that you start doing well in school again. To do this, she asks your bully at school to help you.

[From [url=https://waifuisland.itch.io/beth-and-morty]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
妈妈要求你把学习成绩提回去。为了让你做到这一点，她竟然去请学校里欺负你的那个人来帮你。
